title: A comparative study of gallic acid and its derivatives on the binding to Keap1 and their ability against 6-hydroxydopamine-induced cytotoxicity.
authors: Wan, Shengyang; Li, Aiguo; Dong, Tianbao; Li, Fuhao; Kang, Qing; Min, Jian; Wang, Pengcheng
one_liner_zh: 该研究比较没食子酸及其衍生物与Keap1蛋白的结合及抗细胞毒性作用，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: This study compared gallic acid (GLA) and its derivatives, i.e. ginnalin A (GA), 1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-galloyl-beta-D-glucose (PGG), and (-)-epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) on their ability against 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA)-induced cytotoxicity. Their binding to the Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) Kelch domain was assessed using isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) and molecular docking. Cellular assays, such as ROS quantification, In-Cell Western assay and quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) analysis, were performed using human neuroblastoma (SH-SY5Y) cells to investigate their involvement in the nuclear factor erythroid-2 related factor 2 (Nrf2)/Keap1 and the nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathways. We found that these four natural products (NPs) can activate the Nrf2/Keap1 pathways with GLA exhibiting the highest and EGCG displaying the lowest activating capability. However, their inhibitory effects on the NF-kappaB pathway showed a different order of potencies, with EGCG exerting the least inhibitory effect. All these contribute to overall similar cell viability in counteracting 6-OHDA-induced cytotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 本研究比较了没食子酸（GLA）及其衍生物，即锦纳素A（GA）、1,2,3,4,6-五-O-没食子酰基-β-D-葡萄糖（PGG）和（-）-表没食子儿茶素-3-没食子酸酯（EGCG）对抗6-羟基多巴胺（6-OHDA）诱导的细胞毒性的能力。通过等温滴定量热法（ITC）和分子对接评估了它们与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）Kelch结构域的结合。使用人神经母细胞瘤（SH-SY5Y）细胞进行了细胞实验，如ROS定量、In-Cell Western分析和定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）分析，以研究它们在核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）/Keap1和核因子-κB（NF-κB）通路中的作用。我们发现这四种天然产物（NPs）能激活Nrf2/Keap1通路，其中GLA表现出最高的激活能力，而EGCG表现出最低的激活能力。然而，它们对NF-κB通路的抑制作用显示出不同的效力顺序，其中EGCG的抑制作用最弱。所有这些共同导致了在对抗6-OHDA诱导的细胞毒性时总体相似的细胞活力。
